name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands with her arms open and raised in an invocation, palms turned up, back slightly arched and one foot lightly lifted, drawing a column of light down from above into her hands, a serene, luminous gaze to the camera. A warm rising wind lifts her train, sleeves and hair. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: A column of {{MAGIC}} light pours down into her palms, golden motes and soft rays radiating outward.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
